description: Create notification.py (alert system), reporter.py (super report generator), and update the main README.md. The notification module sends alerts on important events. The reporter generates elite-level reports with correlation maps, attack path visualizations, and bug bounty optimization. Also create super_monster/README.md documentation and update the main Bug-Bounty README.md to mark Super Monster as Ready.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/notification.py (~600 lines): NotificationManager class. Channels: console (colored print), file_log (append to log file), webhook (POST JSON to Discord/Slack/Telegram URL using urllib.request). Event types: NEW_CRITICAL (new CRITICAL/HIGH finding), FINDING_FIXED (previously found now gone), NEW_SUBDOMAIN (new subdomain appeared), STALE_FINDING (finding persists > 30 days), ATTACK_CHAIN_DETECTED (new attack chain found). Notification formatting per channel (markdown for webhook, colored for console, plain for file). Configurable thresholds from config.py. Batch notifications to avoid spam.

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/reporter.py (~1500 lines): SuperReporter class. Generate multiple report formats: JSON (machine-readable full data), Markdown (human-readable with tables), HTML (styled dark-theme interactive). Report sections: correlation maps (ASCII graph showing connections between findings as edges), attack path visualization (tree showing exploitation steps), priority-ranked finding list (from prioritizer), retest history timeline (showing finding lifecycle), business impact assessment (aggregate risk per domain/tier), bug bounty optimization recommendations (what to submit first), HackerOne/Bugcrowd report templates with correlation context and PoC. Color-coded severity badges. Statistics dashboard section.

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/README.md: Full documentation with banner, feature list, installation, usage examples for every subcommand, output examples, architecture explanation, configuration guide.

Update /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/README.md: Change Super Monster entry in the tools table from ':construction: Coming Soon' to ':white_check_mark: Ready' and add link [Super Monster](super_monster/README.md). Update the section below the table to have full description instead of 'Coming Soon'. Add super_monster/ to the project structure section.
